name: Sheet-Pan Andouille Sausage with Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato

fit.note: 494 cal in-band (400-650), 25 g carbs <=35, no seafood, weigh-and-divide sheet-pan roast scalable across pans to 14.

evidence: No catalog pork/sausage sheet-pan roast matches: existing sausage sheet-pans are bratwurst+peppers+potatoes (sheet-pan-bratwurst-peppers-potatoes) and Italian-sausage-meatballs+kale+potatoes (sheet-pan-sausage-meatballs-kale-potatoes) - different protein flavor (bratwurst/Italian vs Cajun andouille) and different veg/starch; catalog Cajun/andouille dishes (cajun-chicken-and-sausage-jambalaya, chicken-sausage-gumbo, one-pot-creamy-cajun-sausage-pasta) are rice/pasta stews, not a roasted-vegetable sheet pan.
cross_protein_flags: STRUCTURAL TWIN in chicken: sheet-pan-chicken-sweet-potato-brussels (Harvest Sheet-Pan Chicken with Sweet Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts) shares the exact starch+veg (sweet potato + Brussels sprouts) and method (sheet-pan roast) - only protein and flavor family (Cajun andouille vs harvest chicken) differ. Decider should confirm the catalog wants both a chicken and a pork-sausage take on the same roasted plate.
Plausible turkey-sausage version: same dish could be sourced with smoked-turkey-sausage as the protein - watch for a selected-turkey twin.

board.note: Andouille has no board home (nearest smoked-turkey-sausage/kielbasa); intentionally kept per v2.1 5.1 to exercise the pricer lane, not penalized.
